justification: Changes Housing SEPP eligibility answers served on the assessment page and by both eligibility engines: dual occupancy now needs a Low and Mid-Rise housing area (s 168(1), s 169(1)), and every SEPP citation page in housing_sepp_standards is corrected.

falsifiable_check.command: python -m pytest tests/test_housing_sepp_eligibility.py tests/test_upzoning_check.py -q && cd frontend-nextjs && npx jest __tests__/api/housing-sepp
falsifiable_check.fails_when: Mutation measured 2026-10-19: dual_occupancy fixture requires_lmr_area set back to False -> test_dual_occupancy_outside_lmr_area_is_not_eligible fails (duplex eligible True).
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Before the fix: live POST /api/housing-sepp/eligibility for 6 Berrigan St (R2, 685 m2, isLMRArea false) returned dual_occupancy eligible with overrides FSR 0.65 vs 0.5 and height 9.5 vs 9; standards cited pdfPage 72 (s 147).
falsifiable_check.external_authority: SEPP (Housing) 2021 PDF at the rows' r2_pdf_url (131 pages, printed 30 Mar 2026): s 168(1) and s 169(1) text read on pp 80-81; each clause and value located with PyMuPDF (s 108 p49, 168 p80, 169(3) p81, 172 p82, 173 p82, 175/176 p83, 179/180 p84).

pre_impl.existing_data: housing_sepp_standards 67 rows; ids 1-7 dual_occupancy requires_lmr_area false; no triggers, no FK references.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Assumed duplex SEPP standards apply to all R2 land; the in-force text limits them to a low and mid rise housing area.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new code path: both readers already gate on requires_lmr_area; data fix plus one reason string.
pre_impl.external_source_error: Not applicable: this change adds no external query; the area answer still comes from the existing map gates.
pre_impl.frontend_type: eligibilityReason stays a plain string and assessmentStatus keeps its three values, so no consumer type changes.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Worst case a lot inside a reform area is unaffected (flag true passes it to its lot tests); outside one, duplex now reads not eligible under the SEPP, with the council controls named.

functions.name: POST /api/housing-sepp/eligibility
functions.input: zone code, lot size, lot width range from the street, isLMRArea true/false/null, optional LEP height and FSR
functions.output: one status per housing form (eligible, ineligible, not_assessed) with a reason and its cited standards, plus SEPP-over-LEP lines
functions.if_none: isLMRArea null or absent gives not_assessed for every area form, now including dual occupancy

break_it.scenario: R2 lot outside any Low and Mid-Rise area (Winston Hills).
break_it.what_happens: Duplex not eligible under the SEPP, no SEPP-beats-LEP lines.
break_it.how: Flag true; overrides only for eligible forms.

break_it.scenario: Lot on heritage land, inside or outside a Low and Mid-Rise area.
break_it.what_happens: Duplex suppressed like the other area forms (s 164(1)(d)); dwelling houses unaffected.
break_it.how: Existing heritage gate keyed on the flag.

break_it.scenario: Migration re-run or rows changed since the check.
break_it.what_happens: The migration raises an exception and nothing is committed to the table.
break_it.how: Every UPDATE matches id + clause + old value and checks ROW_COUNT.

break_it.scenario: R2 lot inside a Low and Mid-Rise area, 685 m2, width 13.38-22.4 m.
break_it.what_happens: Duplex passes the area gate and is decided on its lot size and width as before.
break_it.how: Flag only gates; lot tests unchanged (tests run with in_lmr_area True).

break_it.scenario: The Low and Mid-Rise area answer is unknown because a map layer did not answer.
break_it.what_happens: Duplex reads not assessed, never eligible or ineligible.
break_it.how: Existing null handling now covers duplex too.

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes - after Vercel deploy, 6 Berrigan St Winston Hills: duplex reason ends 'the council's own LEP and DCP controls do'; no 'SEPP standards exceed LEP controls' box.
